acceptance_criteria.description: 16 admitted scopes run on deterministic global 1-second windows in one attempt-bound RuntimeSession/bridge with exactly two active C2 PI loops; the deferred pressure/RAW/T100/chlorine loops are explicitly unavailable and T107 stays out

Full-run independent water identity closes from tick zero (stored + in-transit + initial stocks - cumulative external in + cumulative external out + declared physical losses) through startup, steady operation, disturbances and stop/reset/replay; created water is always a physical failure beyond rounding

Every X3 flow is limited before transfer by source water, reserved receiver capacity, edge/shared-trunk/valve/pump ratings and hydraulic feasibility; a reservation is a capacity token with documented identity/units/acquire-release/queue/cancellation and no double count, and no hidden water loss or deadlock

The two PIs drive the real actuators: the valve changes the measured inlet flow and the pump changes the measured T108 level; feasible SP tracking within the documented settling horizon, disturbance rejection, unreachable-SP saturation with a reason and recovery, interlock/backwash behaviour and AUTO/MANUAL bumpless continuity

Pump head/motor feasibility over the operating envelope, OFF is exactly zero flow and zero energy, energy is integrated with explicit units, and unmodelled energy is unavailable rather than fabricated

Mutations of the physical envelope (invented water, dropped delivery, excess shared-pipe flow, impossible head, motor overload, missing/duplicated initialisation water) fail the oracle/tests; dry/full downstream and queue-pressure cases fail safely without deleting or inventing water

Canonical default is the X3 whole-plant profile at 1 s with deterministic trajectories across reset/new attempt/replay; explicit X2-60s zero-C2 and G21 slice compatibility remain green; no frozen X1 config, X2 behaviour, runcontrol, composition, ASSY or PIM change
